name: Font2
description: Contains font attributes (for example, font name, font size, and color) for an object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an object that represents the application that the Font2 object is used in. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a value indicating the application that the object was created in. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the parent of the Font2 object. Read-only.

properties.name: Bold
properties.description: Gets or sets a value specifying whether the font should be bold. Read/write.

properties.name: Italic
properties.description: Gets or sets a value specifying whether the text for a selection is italic. Read/write.

properties.name: Strike
properties.description: Gets or sets a value specifying the strike format used for a selection of text. Read/write.

properties.name: Caps
properties.description: Gets or sets a value specifying that the text should be capitalized. Read/write.

properties.name: AutorotateNumbers
properties.description: Gets or sets a value that specifies whether the numbers in a numbered list should be rotated when the text is rotated. Read/write.

properties.name: BaselineOffset
properties.description: Gets or sets a value specifying the horizontal offset of the selected font. Read/write.

properties.name: Kerning
properties.description: Gets or sets a value specifying the amount of spacing between text characters. Read/write.

properties.name: Size
properties.description: Gets or sets a value specifying the size of the font. Read/write.

properties.name: Spacing
properties.description: Gets or sets a value specifying the spacing between characters in a selection of text. Read/write.

properties.name: UnderlineStyle
properties.description: Gets or sets a value specifying the underline style for the selected text. Read/write.

properties.name: Allcaps
properties.description: True if the font is formatted as all capital letters. Read/write.

properties.name: DoubleStrikeThrough
properties.description: True if the specified font is formatted as double strikethrough text. Read/write.

properties.name: Equalize
properties.description: Gets or sets a value specifying whether the text for a selection should be spaced equal distances apart. Read/write.

properties.name: Fill
properties.description: Gets the formatting properties for the font of the specified text. Read-only.

properties.name: Glow
properties.description: Gets a value indicating whether the font is displayed as a glow effect. Read-only.

properties.name: Reflection
properties.description: Gets a value specifying the type of reflection format for the selection of text. Read-only.

properties.name: Line
properties.description: Gets a value specifying the format of a line. Read-only.

properties.name: Shadow
properties.description: Gets the value specifying the type of shadow effect for the selection of text. Read-only.

properties.name: Highlight
properties.description: Gets a value indicating whether the font is displayed as highlighted. Read-only.

properties.name: UnderlineColor
properties.description: Gets a value specifying the color of the underline for the selected text. Read-only.

properties.name: Smallcaps
properties.description: Gets or sets a value specifying whether small caps should be used with the selection of text. Small caps are the same height as the lowercase letters in a selection of text. Read/write.

properties.name: SoftEdgeFormat
properties.description: Gets or sets a value specifying the type of soft edge effect used in a selection of text. Read/write.

properties.name: StrikeThrough
properties.description: Gets or sets a value specifying that the text should be rendered in a strikethrough appearance. Read/write.

properties.name: Subscript
properties.description: Gets or sets a value specifying that the selected text should be displayed as subscript. Read/write.

properties.name: Superscript
properties.description: Gets or sets a value specifying that the selected text should be displayed as superscript. Read/write.

properties.name: WordArtformat
properties.description: Gets or sets a value specifying the text effect for the selected text. Read/write.

properties.name: Embeddable
properties.description: Gets a value indicating whether the font can be embedded on a page. Read-only.

properties.name: Embedded
properties.description: Gets a value specifying whether the font is embedded in a page. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Gets or sets a value specifying the font to use for a selection. Read/write.

properties.name: NameAscii
properties.description: Gets or sets the font used for Latin text—characters with character codes from 0 (zero) through 127. Read/write.

properties.name: NameComplexScript
properties.description: Gets or sets the complex script font name. Used for mixed language text. Read/write.

properties.name: NameFarEast
properties.description: Gets or sets an East Asian font name. Read/write.

properties.name: NameOther
properties.description: Gets or sets the font used for characters whose character set numbers are greater than 127. Read/write.
